newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen extending profit-taking fall.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen extending profit-taking fall.

text.p: Polish shares are expected to extend their 1.7 percent fall on Thursday, the last session before the Assumption holiday, analysts said on Monday.

They said investors were taking profits after the recent 14.5 percent, six-session surge, but that the relative cheapness of the bourse to others in the region could spur more buying later in the week.
They said the Dow's Friday plunge would worsen market sentiment on Monday.
Analysts also said some stocks would be affected by July earnings reports, most due after Monday's session.
